title: DuckNet agent chain manifest
description: A chain is an ordered list of isolated Claude sessions. Every stage declares the schema its output must satisfy; stages exchange data only as validated structured JSON, never as prose.

name.description: Chain id. Also the default output directory name.

id.description: Unique within the chain. Names the output files and is how later stages refer to this one.

prompt.description: Repo-relative path to the prompt file.

schema.description: Repo-relative path to the JSON schema this stage's structured output must satisfy.

budget.description: Max spend in USD for this stage, as a decimal string.

tools.description: Comma-separated allowed tools, or 'none' for a no-tool session.

context.description: Blocks appended to the prompt, in order, to build this stage's input.

path_env.description: from=file: environment variable holding the path. Wins over path.

stage.description: from=stage: id of an earlier stage in this chain.

jq.description: from=stage: jq filter applied to that stage's structured output before injection. Use it to strip the producing stage's own argument so the consumer cannot be anchored by it.

format.description: How the block is fenced. Default json for stage, text otherwise.

optional.description: from=file/env: skip the block when absent instead of failing the stage.

skip_if.description: Evaluate a jq predicate against an earlier stage's output; when true this stage is not run and skip_output is written instead.

skip_output.description: Structured output written when skip_if fires. Must satisfy this stage's schema.

on_missing_output.description: What to do when the session returns no structured output or fails validation. fail stops the chain (use for the stage that produces the work). degrade writes degrade_output and continues (use for an assessment stage: losing the assessment must not lose the work).

degrade_output.description: Structured output written when on_missing_output is degrade. Must satisfy this stage's schema.

merge.description: Deterministic join of stage outputs. A script — jq or Python — never a model.

args.description: Placeholders: {{stage:ID}} is that stage's structured output file, {{outdir}} the chain output directory.

output.description: File name written inside the output directory.

schema.description: Optional schema the merged result must satisfy.
